  @moduledoc """
  An Ash type backed by `Ledger.Money`.
  """

  use Ash.Type

  @spec storage_type :: :map
  def storage_type, do: :map

  def cast_input(value, opts) do
    cast_value(value, opts)
  end

  def cast_stored(value, opts) do
    case value do
      %{currency: currency, amount: amount} when is_atom(currency) and is_integer(amount) ->
        apply_constraints(struct!(Ledger.Money, value), opts)

      %{"currency" => currency, "amount" => amount} when is_binary(currency) and is_integer(amount) ->
        case resolve_currency(currency) do
          {:ok, atom_currency} -> apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: atom_currency, amount: amount}, opts)
          _ -> {:error, message: "invalid_format", reason: :invalid_format}
        end

      _ ->
        {:error, message: "invalid_format", reason: :invalid_format}
    end
  end

  def dump(money, _opts) when money == nil do
    {:ok, nil}
  end

  def dump(%Ledger.Money{} = money, _opts) do
    {:ok, %{currency: money.currency, amount: money.amount}}
  end

  def dump(_other, _opts), do: :error

  def dump_to_native(value, opts), do: dump(value, opts)

  def equal?(a, b), do: a == b

  def apply_constraints(nil, _opts), do: {:ok, nil}

  def apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{} = money, opts) do
    cond do
      currencies = opts[:currencies] ->
        if money.currency in currencies do
          check_multiple(money, opts)
        else
          {
            :error,
            message: "currency is not allowed",
            reason: :currency_not_allowed,
            currency: money.currency
          }
        end

      true ->
        check_multiple(money, opts)
    end
  end

  defp check_multiple(money, opts) do
    if multiple = opts[:multiple_of] do
      if rem(money.amount, multiple) == 0 do
        check_min(money, opts)
      else
        {
          :error,
          message: "must be a multiple of %{multiple_of} minor units",
          reason: :not_multiple_of,
          multiple_of: multiple
        }
      end
    else
      check_min(money, opts)
    end
  end

  defp check_min(money, opts) do
    if min = opts[:min] do
      case cast_bound(min, opts) do
        {:ok, min_money} ->
          if money.currency == min_money.currency do
            if compare_amounts(money.amount, min_money.amount) != :lt do
              check_max(money, opts)
            else
              {
                :error,
                message: "must be greater than or equal to %{min}",
                reason: :below_min,
                min: Ledger.Money.to_string(min_money)

            end
          else

          end

        {:error, :currency_mismatch} ->
          {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}

        {:error, _} ->
          check_max(money, opts)
      end
    else
      check_max(money, opts)
    end
  end

  defp check_max(money, opts) do
    if max = opts[:max] do
      case cast_bound(max, opts) do
        {:ok, max_money} ->

            if compare_amounts(money.amount, max_money.amount) != :gt do
              {:ok, money}
            else
              {
                :error,
                message: "must be less than or equal to %{max}",
                reason: :above_max,
                max: Ledger.Money.to_string(max_money)
              }
            end
          else
            {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}
          end

        {:error, :currency_mismatch} ->
          {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}

        {:error, _} ->
          {:ok, money}
      end
    else
      {:ok, money}
    end
  end

      {:error, [reason: :currency_mismatch]} -> {:error, :currency_mismatch}
      _ -> {:error, :unusable}
    end

  defp cast_value(%Ledger.Money{} = money, opts) do

  end

  defp cast_value(value, opts) when is_map(value) do
    case resolve_currency(value[:currency] || value["currency"]) do
      {:ok, currency} ->
        case resolve_amount(value[:amount] || value["amount"], exponent(currency)) do
          {:ok, amount} -> apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: amount}, opts)
          {:fractional, _} -> error(:fractional_minor_units)
          :error -> error(:invalid_format)
        end

      {:error, reason} ->
        error(reason, currency: value[:currency] || value["currency"])
    end
  end

  defp cast_value(value, opts) when is_binary(value) do
    case String.split(value, " ", trim: true) do
      [raw_code, raw_amount] ->
        case resolve_currency(raw_code) do
          {:ok, currency} ->
            exp = exponent(currency)

            case String.split(raw_amount, ".") do
              [int] when exp == 0 ->
                if Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, int) do
                  apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: String.to_integer(int)}, opts)
                else
                  error(:invalid_format)
                end

              [int] ->
                if Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, int) do
                  apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: String.to_integer(int) * int_pow(10, exp)}, opts)
                else
                  error(:invalid_format)
                end

              [int, frac] ->
                if exp == 0 do
                  error(:invalid_format)
                else
                  if Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, int) and Regex.match?(~r/^[0-9]+$/, frac) do
                    if String.length(frac) == exp do
                      abs_int = String.to_integer(int)
                      abs_frac = String.to_integer(frac)
                      # The sign of the amount is determined by the integer part
                      real_sign = if String.starts_with?(int, "-"), do: -1, else: 1
                      amount = real_sign * (abs(abs_int) * int_pow(10, exp) + abs_frac)
                      apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: amount}, opts)
                    else
                      error(:invalid_format)
                    end
                  else
                    error(:invalid_format)
                  end
                end

              _ ->
                error(:invalid_format)
            end

          {:error, reason} ->
            error(reason, currency: raw_code)
        end

      _ ->
        error(:invalid_format)
    end
  end

  defp cast_value(_value, _opts), do: error(:invalid_format)

  defp resolve_currency(value) when is_atom(value) do
    if value in Ledger.Money.currencies() do
      {:ok, value}
    else
      {:error, :unknown_currency}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_currency(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value |> String.trim() |> String.upcase() |> case do
      "BHD" -> {:ok, :bhd}
      "EUR" -> {:ok, :eur}
      "JPY" -> {:ok, :jpy}
      "USD" -> {:ok, :usd}
      _ -> {:error, :unknown_currency}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_currency(_), do: {:error, :unknown_currency}

  defp resolve_amount(value, _exp) when is_integer(value) do
    {:ok, value}
  end

  defp resolve_amount(value, exp) when is_binary(value) do
    cond do
      Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, value) -> {:ok, String.to_integer(value) * int_pow(10, exp)}
      Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/, value) -> {:fractional, value}
      true -> :error
    end
  end

  defp resolve_amount(_value, _exp), do: :error

  defp error(reason, extra \\ []) do
    {:error, [message: message(reason), reason: reason] ++ extra}
  end

  defp message(:unknown_currency), do: "unknown currency"
  defp message(:fractional_minor_units), do: "amount must be a whole number of minor units"
  defp message(:invalid_format), do: "invalid money format"

  defp compare_amounts(a, b) when a < b, do: :lt
  defp compare_amounts(a, b) when a > b, do: :gt
  defp compare_amounts(_, _), do: :eq

  defp exponent(currency), do: Ledger.Money.exponent(currency)
  defp int_pow(base, exp) when exp >= 0, do: Enum.reduce(1..exp, 1, fn _, acc -> acc * base end)
end

defmodule Ledger.Money.Type do
  @moduledoc """
  An Ash type backed by `Ledger.Money`.
  """

  use Ash.Type

  @spec storage_type :: :map
  def storage_type, do: :map

  def cast_input(value, opts) do
    cast_value(value, opts)
  end

  def cast_stored(value, opts) do
    case value do
      %{currency: currency, amount: amount} when is_integer(amount) ->
        apply_constraints_on_stored(currency, amount, opts)

      %{"currency" => currency, "amount" => amount} when is_binary(currency) and is_integer(amount) ->
        apply_constraints_on_stored(currency, amount, opts)

      _ ->
        {:error, message: "invalid_format", reason: :invalid_format}
    end
  end

  defp apply_constraints_on_stored(currency, amount, opts) do
    case resolve_currency(currency) do
      {:ok, atom_currency} -> apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: atom_currency, amount: amount}, opts)
      _ -> {:error, message: "invalid_format", reason: :invalid_format}
    end
  end

  def dump(money, _opts) when money == nil do
    {:ok, nil}
  end

  def dump(%Ledger.Money{} = money, _opts) do
    {:ok, %{currency: money.currency, amount: money.amount}}
  end

  def dump(_other, _opts), do: :error

  def dump_to_native(value, opts), do: dump(value, opts)

  def equal?(a, b), do: a == b

  def apply_constraints(nil, _opts), do: {:ok, nil}

  def apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{} = money, opts) do
    cond do
      currencies = opts[:currencies] ->
        if money.currency in currencies do
          check_multiple(money, opts)
        else
          {
            :error,
            message: "currency is not allowed",
            reason: :currency_not_allowed,
            currency: money.currency
          }
        end

      true ->
        check_multiple(money, opts)
    end
  end

  defp check_multiple(money, opts) do
    if multiple = opts[:multiple_of] do
      if rem(money.amount, multiple) == 0 do
        check_min(money, opts)
      else
        {
          :error,
          message: "must be a multiple of %{multiple_of} minor units",
          reason: :not_multiple_of,
          multiple_of: multiple
        }
      end
    else
      check_min(money, opts)
    end
  end

  defp check_min(money, opts) do
    if min = opts[:min] do
      case cast_bound(min, opts) do
        {:ok, min_money} ->
          if money.currency == min_money.currency do
            if compare_amounts(money.amount, min_money.amount) != :lt do
              check_max(money, opts)
            else
              {
                :error,
                message: "must be greater than or equal to %{min}",
                reason: :below_min,
                min: Ledger.Money.to_string(min_money)
              }
            end
          else
            {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}
          end

        {:error, :currency_mismatch} ->
          {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}

        {:error, _} ->
          check_max(money, opts)
      end
    else
      check_max(money, opts)
    end
  end

  defp check_max(money, opts) do
    if max = opts[:max] do
      case cast_bound(max, opts) do
        {:ok, max_money} ->
          if money.currency == max_money.currency do
            if compare_amounts(money.amount, max_money.amount) != :gt do
              {:ok, money}
            else
              {
                :error,
                message: "must be less than or equal to %{max}",
                reason: :above_max,
                max: Ledger.Money.to_string(max_money)
              }
            end
          else
            {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}
          end

        {:error, :currency_mismatch} ->
          {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}

        {:error, _} ->
          {:ok, money}
      end
    else
      {:ok, money}
    end
  end

  defp cast_bound(value, opts) do
    value |> cast_value(opts) |> case do
      {:ok, money} -> {:ok, money}
      {:error, [reason: :currency_mismatch]} -> {:error, :currency_mismatch}
      _ -> {:error, :unusable}
    end
  end

  defp cast_value(nil, _opts), do: {:ok, nil}

  defp cast_value(%Ledger.Money{} = money, opts) do
    apply_constraints(money, opts)
  end

  defp cast_value(value, opts) when is_map(value) do
    case resolve_currency(value[:currency] || value["currency"]) do
      {:ok, currency} ->
        case resolve_amount(value[:amount] || value["amount"], exponent(currency)) do
          {:ok, amount} -> apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: amount}, opts)
          {:fractional, _} -> error(:fractional_minor_units)
          :error -> error(:invalid_format)
        end

      {:error, reason} ->
        error(reason, currency: value[:currency] || value["currency"])
    end
  end

  defp cast_value(value, opts) when is_binary(value) do
    case String.split(value, " ", trim: true) do
      [raw_code, raw_amount] ->
        case resolve_currency(raw_code) do
          {:ok, currency} ->
            exp = exponent(currency)

            case String.split(raw_amount, ".") do
              [int] when exp == 0 ->
                if Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, int) do
                  apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: String.to_integer(int)}, opts)
                else
                  error(:invalid_format)
                end

              [int] ->
                if Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, int) do
                  apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: String.to_integer(int) * int_pow(10, exp)}, opts)
                else
                  error(:invalid_format)
                end

              [int, frac] ->
                if exp == 0 do
                  error(:invalid_format)
                else
                  if Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, int) and Regex.match?(~r/^[0-9]+$/, frac) do
                    if String.length(frac) == exp do
                      abs_int = String.to_integer(int)
                      abs_frac = String.to_integer(frac)
                      # The sign of the amount is determined by the integer part
                      real_sign = if String.starts_with?(int, "-"), do: -1, else: 1
                      amount = real_sign * (abs(abs_int) * int_pow(10, exp) + abs_frac)
                      apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: amount}, opts)
                    else
                      error(:invalid_format)
                    end
                  else
                    error(:invalid_format)
                  end
                end

              _ ->
                error(:invalid_format)
            end

          {:error, reason} ->
            error(reason, currency: raw_code)
        end

      _ ->
        error(:invalid_format)
    end
  end

  defp cast_value(_value, _opts), do: error(:invalid_format)

  defp resolve_currency(value) when is_atom(value) do
    if value in Ledger.Money.currencies() do
      {:ok, value}
    else
      {:error, :unknown_currency}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_currency(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value |> String.trim() |> String.upcase() |> case do
      "BHD" -> {:ok, :bhd}
      "EUR" -> {:ok, :eur}
      "JPY" -> {:ok, :jpy}
      "USD" -> {:ok, :usd}
      _ -> {:error, :unknown_currency}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_currency(_), do: {:error, :unknown_currency}

  defp resolve_amount(value, _exp) when is_integer(value) do
    {:ok, value}
  end

  defp resolve_amount(value, exp) when is_binary(value) do
    cond do
      Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, value) -> {:ok, String.to_integer(value) * int_pow(10, exp)}
      Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/, value) -> {:fractional, value}
      true -> :error
    end
  end

  defp resolve_amount(_value, _exp), do: :error

  defp error(reason, extra \\ []) do
    {:error, [message: message(reason), reason: reason] ++ extra}
  end

  defp message(:unknown_currency), do: "unknown currency"
  defp message(:fractional_minor_units), do: "amount must be a whole number of minor units"
  defp message(:invalid_format), do: "invalid money format"

  defp compare_amounts(a, b) when a < b, do: :lt
  defp compare_amounts(a, b) when a > b, do: :gt
  defp compare_amounts(_, _), do: :eq

  defp exponent(currency), do: Ledger.Money.exponent(currency)
  defp int_pow(base, exp) when exp >= 0, do: Enum.reduce(1..exp, 1, fn _, acc -> acc * base end)
end

  @moduledoc """
  An Ash type backed by `Ledger.Money`.
  """

  use Ash.Type

  @spec storage_type :: :map
  def storage_type, do: :map

  def constraints, do: [:currencies, :min, :max, :multiple_of]

  def cast_input(value, opts) do
    cast_value(value, opts)
  end

  def cast_stored(value, opts) do
    case value do
      %{currency: currency, amount: amount} when is_integer(amount) ->
        apply_constraints_on_stored(currency, amount, opts)

      %{"currency" => currency, "amount" => amount} when is_binary(currency) and is_integer(amount) ->
        apply_constraints_on_stored(currency, amount, opts)

      _ ->
        {:error, message: "invalid_format", reason: :invalid_format}
    end
  end

  defp apply_constraints_on_stored(currency, amount, opts) do
    case resolve_currency(currency) do
      {:ok, atom_currency} -> apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: atom_currency, amount: amount}, opts)
      _ -> {:error, message: "invalid_format", reason: :invalid_format}
    end
  end

  def dump(money, _opts) when money == nil do
    {:ok, nil}
  end

  def dump(%Ledger.Money{} = money, _opts) do
    {:ok, %{currency: money.currency, amount: money.amount}}
  end

  def dump(_other, _opts), do: :error

  def dump_to_native(value, opts), do: dump(value, opts)

  def equal?(a, b), do: a == b

  def apply_constraints(nil, _opts), do: {:ok, nil}

  def apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{} = money, opts) do
    cond do
      currencies = opts[:currencies] ->
        if money.currency in currencies do
          check_multiple(money, opts)
        else
          {
            :error,
            message: "currency is not allowed",
            reason: :currency_not_allowed,
            currency: money.currency
          }
        end

      true ->
        check_multiple(money, opts)
    end
  end

  defp check_multiple(money, opts) do
    if multiple = opts[:multiple_of] do
      if rem(money.amount, multiple) == 0 do
        check_min(money, opts)
      else
        {
          :error,
          message: "must be a multiple of %{multiple_of} minor units",
          reason: :not_multiple_of,
          multiple_of: multiple
        }
      end
    else
      check_min(money, opts)
    end
  end

  defp check_min(money, opts) do
    if min = opts[:min] do
      case cast_bound(min, opts) do
        {:ok, min_money} ->
          if money.currency == min_money.currency do
            if compare_amounts(money.amount, min_money.amount) != :lt do
              check_max(money, opts)
            else
              {
                :error,
                message: "must be greater than or equal to %{min}",
                reason: :below_min,
                min: Ledger.Money.to_string(min_money)
              }
            end
          else
            {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}
          end

        {:error, :currency_mismatch} ->
          {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}

        {:error, _} ->
          check_max(money, opts)
      end
    else
      check_max(money, opts)
    end
  end

  defp check_max(money, opts) do
    if max = opts[:max] do
      case cast_bound(max, opts) do
        {:ok, max_money} ->
          if money.currency == max_money.currency do
            if compare_amounts(money.amount, max_money.amount) != :gt do
              {:ok, money}
            else
              {
                :error,
                message: "must be less than or equal to %{max}",
                reason: :above_max,
                max: Ledger.Money.to_string(max_money)
              }
            end
          else
            {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}
          end

        {:error, :currency_mismatch} ->
          {:error, message: "cannot compare money in different currencies", reason: :currency_mismatch}

        {:error, _} ->
          {:ok, money}
      end
    else
      {:ok, money}
    end
  end

  defp cast_bound(value, opts) do
    value |> cast_value(opts) |> case do
      {:ok, money} -> {:ok, money}
      {:error, [reason: :currency_mismatch]} -> {:error, :currency_mismatch}
      _ -> {:error, :unusable}
    end
  end

  defp cast_value(nil, _opts), do: {:ok, nil}

  defp cast_value(%Ledger.Money{} = money, opts) do
    apply_constraints(money, opts)
  end

  defp cast_value(value, opts) when is_map(value) do
    case resolve_currency(value[:currency] || value["currency"]) do
      {:ok, currency} ->
        case resolve_amount(value[:amount] || value["amount"], exponent(currency)) do
          {:ok, amount} -> apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: amount}, opts)
          {:fractional, _} -> error(:fractional_minor_units)
          :error -> error(:invalid_format)
        end

      {:error, reason} ->
        error(reason, currency: value[:currency] || value["currency"])
    end
  end

  defp cast_value(value, opts) when is_binary(value) do
    case String.split(value, " ", trim: true) do
      [raw_code, raw_amount] ->
        case resolve_currency(raw_code) do
          {:ok, currency} ->
            exp = exponent(currency)

            case String.split(raw_amount, ".") do
              [int] when exp == 0 ->
                if Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, int) do
                  apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: String.to_integer(int)}, opts)
                else
                  error(:invalid_format)
                end

              [int] ->
                if Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, int) do
                  apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: String.to_integer(int) * int_pow(10, exp)}, opts)
                else
                  error(:invalid_format)
                end

              [int, frac] ->
                if exp == 0 do
                  error(:invalid_format)
                else
                  if Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, int) and Regex.match?(~r/^[0-9]+$/, frac) do
                    if String.length(frac) == exp do
                      abs_int = String.to_integer(int)
                      abs_frac = String.to_integer(frac)
                      # The sign of the amount is determined by the integer part
                      real_sign = if String.starts_with?(int, "-"), do: -1, else: 1
                      amount = real_sign * (abs(abs_int) * int_pow(10, exp) + abs_frac)
                      apply_constraints(%Ledger.Money{currency: currency, amount: amount}, opts)
                    else
                      error(:invalid_format)
                    end
                  else
                    error(:invalid_format)
                  end
                end

              _ ->
                error(:invalid_format)
            end

          {:error, reason} ->
            error(reason, currency: raw_code)
        end

      _ ->
        error(:invalid_format)
    end
  end

  defp cast_value(_value, _opts), do: error(:invalid_format)

  defp resolve_currency(value) when is_atom(value) do
    if value in Ledger.Money.currencies() do
      {:ok, value}
    else
      {:error, :unknown_currency}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_currency(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value |> String.trim() |> String.upcase() |> case do
      "BHD" -> {:ok, :bhd}
      "EUR" -> {:ok, :eur}
      "JPY" -> {:ok, :jpy}
      "USD" -> {:ok, :usd}
      _ -> {:error, :unknown_currency}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_currency(_), do: {:error, :unknown_currency}

  defp resolve_amount(value, _exp) when is_integer(value) do
    {:ok, value}
  end

  defp resolve_amount(value, exp) when is_binary(value) do
    cond do
      Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+$/, value) -> {:ok, String.to_integer(value) * int_pow(10, exp)}
      Regex.match?(~r/^-?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/, value) -> {:fractional, value}
      true -> :error
    end
  end

  defp resolve_amount(_value, _exp), do: :error

  defp error(reason, extra \\ []) do
    {:error, [message: message(reason), reason: reason] ++ extra}
  end

  defp message(:unknown_currency), do: "unknown currency"
  defp message(:fractional_minor_units), do: "amount must be a whole number of minor units"
  defp message(:invalid_format), do: "invalid money format"

  defp compare_amounts(a, b) when a < b, do: :lt
  defp compare_amounts(a, b) when a > b, do: :gt
  defp compare_amounts(_, _), do: :eq

  defp exponent(currency), do: Ledger.Money.exponent(currency)
  defp int_pow(base, exp) when exp >= 0, do: Enum.reduce(1..exp, 1, fn _, acc -> acc * base end)
end
